name: official-checkpoint reference baseline (Greene)
question: Clean closed-loop success of the released OpenWAM-Alpha-Sim-RoboTwin-Full checkpoint on the same 3 tasks x 20 clean scenes used by the native295M temporal study.
source: research/experiments/NEXT_STEPS.md: 'register the official reference baseline (initial proposal: 3 tasks x 20 clean episodes)'

policy.note: action RNG uses SeedSequence([scene, 42, 811]) as in the temporal study, so action seeds pair with the seed-42 routes

serving: identical to the temporal-study harness: compile off, DiT cache off, denoise_steps 10, inference_horizon 8, prompt cache 32

evaluation.cohort: first 20 accepted entries per task of the sealed temporal-20260926 cohort (rebuilt byte-exact on Greene)
evaluation.success: native RoboTwin eval_success, native step limits, 600 s per-episode wall limit
evaluation.render_gate: initial state atol 1e-6 and per-camera initial render MAE <= 1 uint8 vs GPU02 reference PNGs; a render mismatch is recorded as a technical failure and the next scene continues

deviations_from_official_protocol: 3 tasks not 50, 20 not 100 episodes/task, fixed sealed scenes not seed-0 stream, compile/cache off, horizon 8. This is a reference point for the reduced study, not an official benchmark reproduction.
cell_isolation: route 'official' cells do not exist in the GPU02 1080-cell matrix; no GPU02 cell is executed here and outcomes are never merged with GPU02 outcomes.
